_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for tier thresholds. Aligned with the BO Power BI tier computation (Computed_Tier in /Power BI/BO_Dashboard/retailer_quarter.csv): quarterly revenue, Yellow 50k-1.5L, Green 1.5L-3L, Silver 3L-5L, Gold 5L-10L, Platinum above 10L; an amount on a boundary belongs to the higher tier. Until Q1 FY 27 (quarters before July 2026) Green was 1.5L-2.5L and Silver 2.5L-5L (see 'earlier').
qualification_basis_note: Tiers are qualified on sales in the selected eligible reporting period (default: quarter), not lifetime sales. Whether 'sales' means gross, net of returns, or billed value is NOT confirmed.
effective_from_note: A tier with effective_from only applies to quarters starting on or after that date. Platinum starts in Q1 FY 27 (April 2026); earlier quarters top out at Gold, which then has no upper limit.
boundary_rule_note: lower_inclusive: min <= x < max (150000 is Green, 500000 is Gold), as in the BO Power BI computed tiers. Allowed: lower_inclusive, upper_inclusive, unconfirmed.
below_minimum_note: Treatment of retailers below the lowest threshold is not confirmed; they are returned with tier = null.
earlier_note: A tier's 'earlier' list holds amounts that applied to quarters starting before the given date: Silver started at 2.5L (Green ended at 2.5L) until Q1 FY 27; from Q2 FY 27 (July 2026) Silver is 3L-5L and Green 1.5L-3L.
